name: Rogue
text: Skin Contact − Action: Attach Touched to another character. You gain each of the attached character's [[TRAITS]] until the end of the round. (Limit once per round.) Forced Response: After the player phase begins, find Touched and set it aside.

name: Touched
text:
If Touched is attached to a:
Minion − Rogue's attacks gain overkill.
Villain − Rogue gains retaliate 1.
Ally − Rogue gains the [[AERIAL]] trait.
Hero − Rogue gains stalwart.

name: Gambit
text: Gambit enters play with 3 charge counters on him. [star] Interrupt: When Gambit attacks, remove 1 charge counter from him → deal 1 damage to an enemy.

name: Rogue's Jacket
text:
While Touched is attached to a friendly character, Rogue gets +1 THW.
While Touched is attached to a enemy character, Rogue gets +1 ATK.

name: Goin' Rogue
text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If Rogue has: • [[AERIAL]], remove 2 additional threat. • Retaliate, confuse an enemy. • Stalwart, draw 1 card.

name: Southern Cross
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. If Rogue has: • [[AERIAL]], this attack deals 2 additional damage. • Retaliate, stun that enemy. • Stalwart, draw 1 card.

name: Energy Transfer
text: Hero Action: Attach Touched to a character other than Rogue and deal 2 damage to that character → heal 2 damage from Rogue and ready her. You gain each of the attached character's [[TRAITS]] until the end of the round.

name: Bulletproof Belle
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy with Touched attached to it attacks, prevent all damage from that attack and gain a tough status card.

name: Superpower Adaptation
text: Hero Action: If Touched is attached to a friendly character, search its owner's discard pile for an event that belong's to the same classification as that character (identity-specific, aspect, or basic) → add that event to your hand.

name: Iceman
text: Iceman enters play with 3 freeze counters on him. Response: After a minion enters play, remove 1 freeze counter from Iceman → stun that minion.

name: Karma
text: Response: After you play Karma from your hand, choose a non-[[ELITE]] minion. While Karma is in play, take control of that minion and treat it as a [[CONTROLLED]] ally with a blank text box. Its THW is equal to its printed SCH and it takes 2 consequential damage after it thwarts or attacks.

name: Armor
text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-MEN]] trait.
Toughness.
flavor: "Good luck getting through my impenetrable psionic exoskeleton."

name: Unflappable
text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you defend against an attack and take no damage, exhaust Unflappable → draw 1 card.

name: Judoka Skill
text: Uses (3 judo counters). Max 1 per player. Interrupt: When you defend against an enemy attack, remove 1 judo counter from here → that enemy gets -2 ATK for that attack.

name: Preemptive Strike
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When a boost card is turned face up while the villain attacks, cancel all boost icons ([boost]) on that card. Then deal 1 damage to the villain for each boost icon cancelled this way.

name: Not Today!
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When your hero defends against an attack, it gets +2 DEF for that attack. If you take no damage from that attack, remove 2 threat from a scheme.

name: Defensive Energy
text: Max 2 per deck. Hero Interrupt: When you spend this card to play a [[Defense]] event, draw 1 card.

name: Moira MacTaggert
text: Play only if your identity has the [[MUTANT]] trait. Response: After a [[MUTANT]] alter-ego changes into hero form, exhaust Moira MacTaggert → that hero's controller draws 1 card.

name: X-Gene
text: Play only if your identity has the [[MUTANT]] trait. Max 1 per player Resource: Exhaust X-Gene → generate a [wild] resource for an identity-specific event.

name: Beauty and the Thief
text: Team-Up (Gambit and Rogue). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. Remove 4 threat from a scheme.

name: Energy
text: Max 1 per deck.

name: Genius
text: Max 1 per deck.

name: Strength
text: Max 1 per deck.

name: Deadly Touch
text: Give to the Anna Marie player • If Touched is attached to a friendly character, deal 2 damage to that character. Discard this card. • If Touched is not attached to a friendly character, place 2 threat on the main scheme. Discard this card.

name: Mystique
text: Toughness. Villainous. Forced Response: After Mystique engages you, search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for a copy of the Misled treachery and shuffle it into your deck.

name: Mystique's Manipulations
text: When Defeated: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of the Misled treachery and shuffle it into your deck.
flavor: While she knows Mystique can't be trusted, Rogue still finds it hard to reject the woman who raised her.

name: Misled
text: When Revealed: Shuffle this card into your deck. This card gains surge. Forced Response: After this card enters your hand, place 2 threat on the main scheme. (You may discard this card from your hand at the end of the player phase like any other card.)

name: Med Lab
text: Max 1 per player. Response: After an ally is defeated by consequential damage, exhaust Med Lab → place it here. (Limit 1 ally at a time.) Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Med Lab → play the ally here as if it was in your hand. It enters play exhausted.

name: Donald Pierce
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). Villainous. Forced Response: After Donald Pierce engages you, reveal the topmost [[REAVER]] minion from the discard pile.

name: Skullbuster
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). Toughness. Forced Response: After Skullbuster engages you, place 1 threat on the main scheme for each [[REAVER]] minion engaged with you.

name: Bonebreaker
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). Toughness. Forced Response: After Bonebreaker engages you, take 1 indirect damage for each [[REAVER]] minion engaged with you.

name: Wade Cole
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of the Cybernetic Enhancements attachment and attach it to Wade Cole. (Shuffle.)

name: Murray Reese
text: Teamwork ([[REAVER]]). When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of the Cybernetic Enhancements attachment and attach it to Murray Reese. (Shuffle.)

name: The Reavers
text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme discards cards from the encounter deck until a [[REAVER]] minion is discarded, then reveals that minion.

name: Cybernetic Enhancements
text: Attach to a minion. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Attached minion cannot take damage. [star] Forced Response: After attached minion attacks, discard Cybernetic Enhancements.
